versions.changelog:
Initial release of 3d-anime-poster-generator:

- Generate 3D anime posters with volumetric lighting and cinematic depth.
- Supports dynamic compositions suitable for wallpapers, merch, and print-on-demand art.
- Uses the Neta AI image generation API (requires token).
- Offers customization: size options (portrait, landscape, square, tall) and style reference image.
- Simple command-line usage for quick poster creation.
